claims.disproof_condition: 條件：HCE 的 DART 出現這份合約的정정（金額、期間變更）或해지（解除）公示，或之後的分季報告寫出對 PSI 的長缸體供應中止。核查頻率：每季（HCE 的 DART 公示與分季報告）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註或降 confidence，重讀往復式機組層上游段與 PSI 敘事。
claims.statement: Supplier-side regulatory disclosure (HD Construction Equipment, DART single sales/supply contract filing, 2026-11-10): a supply contract for engine long blocks for gas power generation with Power Solutions International Inc, supply region United States, KRW 165.5 billion (USD 121,888,800 at the contract-date rate), term 2027-01-01 to 2028-12-31, 10% advance payment and 90% billed as supply proceeds; the amount equals 4.38% of the most recent annual revenue, which is the pre-merger 2025 consolidated revenue of HD Hyundai Construction Equipment (the company absorbed HD Hyundai Infracore on 2026-01-01). Matches PSI's 8-K of the same contract from the buyer side.
